sources.scope: gtv_shelf_pins accessory (catalog/packs/core_2026_06/accessories/gtv_shelf_pins.json) — 'Shelf supports small (Ø5 pin class)'. Currently browse-grade only: pages known, no numeric drilling table transcribed yet — this rule table's diameter/depth numbers below come from the mined dataset and the System-32 standard cross-reference, NOT from a direct read of pages 246-247.
het_shelf_supports accessory — same browse-grade caveat as above.

sources.document: 32 mm cabinetmaking system (Wikipedia, summarizing the DIN/industry System-32 standard)
sources.scope: normative pattern spec: 'columns of 5mm holes with centres at 32mm intervals'; hole depth 12-14mm; shelf-pin length 15-16mm; pin flange diameter ~7mm; first row 37mm from the front edge; rear row 37mm from the rear edge/inner face of the back panel; row spacing in multiples of 32mm. Encyclopedia summary, not a primary manufacturer document — cite the underlying DIN 68-something standard directly before promoting to verified:true.

sources.retrieved_via: WebFetch, 2026-08-03 — provisional page number, not manually spot-checked
sources.scope: shelf-support load groups: 'Load group L 50 (50 kg/m²)' and 'Load group L 75 (75 kg/m²)', shown across Hettich's Safety / Sekura 1.1 / Sekura 2.1 / Sekura 6 / Universal D / Duplo / Push-in shelf-support lines. These are Hettich's OWN load classes, not GTV's — cross-brand load-rating equivalence for GTV's Ø5 pin is unconfirmed.

bands.confidence: high on diameter+pitch, medium on depth — Ø5 and 32mm pitch match both the System-32 standard and the mined dataset; the 11mm depth is inside the standard's 12-14mm band but at its low edge (could be an 11mm-vs-12mm rounding/tolerance artifact in the mined XML, not a deliberate factory choice).

load_rating_bands_UNVERIFIED.source: Hettich only, not yet mapped to GTV's Ø5 pin class
Hettich only, not yet mapped to GTV's Ø5 pin class

placement_principles_from_source: System-32 standard: first hole row 37mm from the front edge; rear hole row 37mm from the rear edge / inner face of the back panel; row spacing in multiples of 32mm.

Mined evidence text confirms 'Ø5×11 column on face 5/6 (front/back rows)' — i.e. the factory drills front AND back rows, consistent with the standard's two-row pattern, but the extractor has not yet recorded the 37mm edge offset as a measured value (only the column existence and pitch).

mined_cross_check.verdict: Small sample (12 rows, all from the same evidence pattern 'Ø5×11 column ... front/back rows') but internally 100% consistent. Weakest-evidence family after screw and rafix_20 by row count, but unlike screw it has at least a real cross-referenced normative standard (System-32) plus factory hits.

engine_notes: Diameter and pitch are solid (System-32 + mined agreement). Depth (11 vs standard 12-14mm) and load rating are both open: (1) re-render GTV pp.246-247 and Hettich pp.810-811/814-815 to get manufacturer-stated depth and load-per-pin numbers rather than relying on a third-party encyclopedia summary and a different brand's load classes; (2) the L50/L75 load bands are left in a clearly separate 'UNVERIFIED' key rather than merged into bands, specifically so the engine cannot accidentally treat a Hettich load class as validated for the GTV default SKU.
replay_evidence_R43: DB/37_JOINT_SELECTION_RULES.md §4 replayed a held-out real cabinet: 8 new face Ø5×11mm instances (divider×4, both sides×2 each), all depth-11mm, 8/8 consistent with the existing band. Role pattern observed: the divider (an interior panel between two shelves) carries pin columns on BOTH its faces (face 5 and face 6 in the machine frame — see DB/37 §1 on why 'face N' is not yet a portable orientation signal), while each side panel carries pins on one face only. Consistent with the System-32 two-row front/back pattern already noted, adds no new depth or load evidence.
